goal: Convert a successful query-edge runtime qualification into one scientifically bounded routed-specialist training experiment without changing the qualified architecture or reopening heldout data.

objective.new_task: field-selection CE plus margin on fresh query-edge causal TRAIN
objective.routing: explicit relevant-edge supervision among same-relation candidates using edge-query/language-state compatibility
objective.preservation: KL distillation from frozen parent on ordinary and endpoint TRAIN-only anchors

method_lessons: Once edge-specific binding is architecturally available, supervise routing explicitly rather than trusting downstream loss to discover useful allocation.
Protect a proven shared expert with teacher-output preservation on old-task TRAIN data while keeping DEV independent.
Do not add gradient surgery, more routers, or other mechanisms before the simpler routed-specialist hypothesis is tested.
A bounded operating budget is an experiment constraint, not a product capability ceiling.
